Art_Airside_Access_Breach.title: Airside Access Breach
Art_Airside_Access_Breach.rule_text: The airside access breach article covers unauthorized entry into a restricted airside area and carries a fine or short detention.

Art_Runway_Drone_Interference.title: Runway Drone Interference
Art_Runway_Drone_Interference.rule_text: The runway drone interference article covers unauthorized airside access combined with drone activity near an active runway and carries imprisonment of not more than 3 years.

Art_Navigation_Signal_Interference.title: Navigation Signal Interference
Art_Navigation_Signal_Interference.rule_text: The navigation signal interference article covers signal interference that produces an aviation warning and carries imprisonment of between 3 and 7 years.

Art_Compound_Airspace_Hazard.title: Compound Airspace Hazard
Art_Compound_Airspace_Hazard.rule_text: The compound airspace hazard article covers both runway drone interference and navigation signal interference and carries imprisonment of between 7 and 15 years.

Art_Maintenance_Window_Authorization.title: Maintenance Window Authorization
Art_Maintenance_Window_Authorization.rule_text: The maintenance window authorization article covers airside conduct supported by complete maintenance authorization records and carries no criminal liability.

Art_Emergency_Tarmac_Authorization.title: Emergency Tarmac Authorization
Art_Emergency_Tarmac_Authorization.rule_text: The emergency tarmac authorization article covers airside conduct under documented medical-diversion rescue records and carries no criminal liability.

rules.name: entry_facts_imply_prohibited_airside_entry
rules.natural_text: Prohibited airside entry is present if any one of the following occurs: a person enters without a badge, uses an expired airport badge, or follows a service vehicle through the gate.

rules.name: restriction_facts_imply_restricted_airside_status
rules.natural_text: Restricted airside status is present when the area is marked restricted and no escort officer is present.

rules.name: drone_facts_imply_runway_drone_operation
rules.natural_text: Runway-area drone operation is present when a person either launches a drone near the runway or pilots one above a service road.

rules.name: runway_lights_imply_active_runway_risk
rules.natural_text: Active runway risk is present when the runway lights are active.

rules.name: signal_facts_imply_signal_interference_conduct
rules.natural_text: Signal-interference conduct is present when a person either transmits an unlicensed beacon or jams a tower channel.

rules.name: warning_fact_implies_aviation_warning_effect
rules.natural_text: An aviation warning effect is present when a pilot warning is received.

rules.name: maintenance_facts_imply_maintenance_authorization_records
rules.natural_text: Maintenance authorization records are complete when there is a work order, the person stays within the assigned zone, and exit is logged before closure.

rules.name: emergency_facts_imply_emergency_tarmac_records
rules.natural_text: Emergency tarmac records are complete when a medical diversion is announced, the rescue route is followed, and the patient transfer form is carried.

rules.name: entry_and_restriction_imply_airside_access_violation
rules.natural_text: An airside access violation is established by prohibited airside entry into a restricted airside area.

rules.name: airside_drone_and_risk_imply_runway_drone_interference
rules.natural_text: Runway drone interference is established when an airside access violation is combined with runway-area drone operation and active runway risk.

rules.name: signal_and_warning_imply_navigation_signal_interference
rules.natural_text: Navigation signal interference is established when signal-interference conduct produces an aviation warning effect.

rules.name: runway_and_signal_imply_compound_airspace_hazard
rules.natural_text: A compound airspace hazard is established when runway drone interference and navigation signal interference are both present.

rules.name: airside_and_maintenance_imply_maintenance_window_authorization
rules.natural_text: Maintenance window authorization is established when the airside conduct is supported by complete maintenance authorization records.

rules.name: airside_and_emergency_imply_emergency_tarmac_authorization
rules.natural_text: Emergency tarmac authorization is established when the airside conduct is supported by complete medical-diversion rescue records.
